xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex71032026-10-1510-36-54" status="unreviewed">  <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">rngog</rs> na re sbyor ba dang ldan pas mkhyen gsum la sgrib pa'i bud gi sreg par bshad pa mi legs ste dang sbyor ba dang ldan pa'i sems skyed kyis mkhyen pa gsuM kyi chud gi sreg par bshad pa le de ni sa'i skye bo'i sems skyed yin pas des sreg par mi nus la gnyis pa bu ta'i ang la sems skyed 'dod pa yang mi bde ste | de ni 'bras bu thob zin yin pas na de ma 'dun pa med pas seMs <lb edRef="inst:5176" n="46b6"/> mtshan nyid kyang smon laM gyi ngo bor gyur pai 'dun pa med kyang snying rje'i ngo bor gzung pa'i 'dun pa yod pa mi 'gal te dmyigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po yang bshad la gzhan don du snang pa bsam po yod pa yang <lb edRef="inst:5176" n="46b7"/> skyed kyi mtshan nyid kyis ma khyab po zer ba la </seg></TEI>
